reasons: internal/app/mcpoauth_test.go:409-432 (TestMCPOAuthRefusesBadTokensAndLogsWhichCheckFailed) captures the refusal log and asserts the message and the original cause, but never asserts the request ID. auth.go:215 does log `request_id` via middleware.GetReqID and I confirmed with a scratch test through the full handler that it is non-empty (e.g. request_id=DESKTOP-.../KrnnKxJCOY-000004), so the code is right — but the campaign rule 'token refusal log tests must capture output and assert both the original error and a non-empty request ID' is not met, and a later change that drops the field or passes an empty string would go unnoticed. Fix: in the `refused` helper (or once after it), assert `logs.String()` matches `request_id=\S+` and does not contain `request_id=""`; keep using the existing bytes.Buffer + slog.NewTextHandler capture already in that test. No production code change is needed.
notes: Verified against a throwaway postgres:16: `go test ./... -count=1` all green (internal/app 54s), the 8 TestMCPOAuth* tests also pass with -race, `go vet` clean.

Mutation check: putting oidc.NewProvider back under oauthMu makes TestMCPOAuthDiscoveryIsNotSerializedAndHonoursCancellation fail (healthy issuer waited 9.99s) — the discovery test really pins the fix. Waiter cancellation via ctx.Done() is also asserted; the initiator's own ctx is honoured by the same select.

Host fallback: mcpResource(r) is gone; Resource = mcp.oauth.resource else general.base_url+/mcp via publicBaseURL(ctx, nil), active() requires it, updateSettings refuses enable with mcp_oauth_incomplete when both empty (validated before any save, all-or-nothing preserved). Test covers refusal, table-forced enable → metadata 404 + forged X-Forwarded-Host token 401 without challenge, and with base_url set the forged-host token is still 401 while challenge/metadata name only the configured resource.

Protected-file checks: migration 0016 is INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING with mcp.oauth.enabled='false' (additive, off by default; fresh install serves metadata 404 and no WWW-Authenticate, tested). Only new unauthenticated routes are the RFC 9728 metadata paths. No account creation, no role from token claims, deactivated accounts refused, empty scope intersection refused (mcp required) — all exercised through the real handler. Tokens/secrets are not logged; refusal message carries only aud/azp values. Key-path filterAllowedScopes refactor is behaviour-preserving (validScopes already limits keys to read/write/mcp).

Minor, not blocking: docs/ADMIN_GUIDE.pdf was regenerated in c10f7b5 but not after 715a242, so the shipped PDF still describes the removed Host fallback that ADMIN_GUIDE.md:233 now denies; regenerate before/with release if the PDF is part of it. Also mcpOAuthConfig logs a Warn on every /mcp request (and every /mcp 401) while the table holds enabled=true with an empty issuer/resource — noisy but only in a hand-edited-table state.
